title: HiBy R3 driver source and OEM module port inventory
paths_relative_to: compas-player repository root; sibling artifacts use ../ relative paths
scope: Host-only inventory and port planning for the two extracted R3 firmware models. All actual OEM modules are selected by default. This file makes no compatibility, build, ABI, or runtime pass claim.

readme.claim: README states 31 open drop-in replacements for HiBy modules; describes bcm_wlbt_power separately as a cywdhd replacement.

source_kit.spdx_handling: Every source file records its literal SPDX-License-Identifier when present in its opening 2048 bytes; null means no file-level identifier found. The kit LICENSE is recorded separately; no per-file license is inferred.

port_order.name: shared_utils_allocator
port_order.reason: Establish exact symbol/provider and reserved-memory contracts before dependent module work. This is a work sequence, not a statement that these sources build or run on either target.

port_order.name: board_peripherals
port_order.modules: All exact per-board OEM module names categorized board_peripherals.
port_order.reason: Handle board GPIO, keys, touch, power, USB Type-C, regulators, and bus wiring against each board DT and loader script.

port_order.name: audio_coordinated
port_order.modules: All exact per-board OEM module names categorized audio_coordinated.
port_order.reason: Port as a coordinated DMA/I2S/codecs/sound-card group because the modules share kernel and userspace ABI.

port_order.name: display_independent
port_order.modules: All exact per-board OEM module names categorized display_independent.
port_order.reason: Keep each panel contract model-specific; the panel module is part of the scanout ABI.

port_order.name: radio_independent
port_order.reason: Retain OEM radio by default. An optional brcmfmac path is a separate migration candidate with board-specific power/wake wiring; do not substitute it implicitly.

source_archive.source_class: local saved original firmware archive; no independent vendor signature was checked

extract_manifest.extract_procedure: 7z unpacked UPT; verified OTA chunks using chained filename MD5 convention and ota_md5 markers; assembled ordered image bytes; verified uImage header+payload CRC32; extracted embedded FDT; unsquashfs extracted complete rootfs.

inventory.note: Counts are distinct: R3 Pro II extracted OEM inventory has 32 modules; R3II 2025 has 31. Kit README describes 31 OEM drop-ins plus bcm_wlbt_power as optional cywdhd replacement.

display_contract.evidence: Extracted OEM panel modules and firmware kernel/module audit; raw enumerations retained. Do not transfer these values between models.

stock_radio_wiring.policy: OEM cywdhd remains selected. Parameters document the board stock driver and must not be assumed to match bcm_wlbt_power.

board_support_status.r3proii: not validated as a replacement for this extracted board; stock cywdhd uses PF02/PC25/PF03/PF05 while source comments mention R3 Pro II and R1 wiring but no exact R3ProII board setup is proven here
board_support_status.r3ii_2025: no native board wiring or runtime validation; OEM cywdhd script uses PA19/PB24/PA18/PA12

optional_non_oem_alternatives.warning: Source presence does not establish ABI or runtime compatibility. Requires explicit board wiring, SDIO lifecycle, firmware, userspace, and validation.

evidence_cautions: OEM module hashes identify files in the fresh local extraction, not independently vendor-signed artifacts.
Source directory/name match is only source availability. It does not establish matching vermagic, imported/exported symbols, struct ABI, behavior, or board wiring.
The R3II 2025 board has no board-specific source tree in the pinned kit. Never alias R3 Pro II board sources to R3II 2025.

For the display, preserve raw framebuffer format and LCD mode values per model: R3 Pro II 480x720/fb_fmt=1/lcd_mode=0; R3II 2025 320x480/fb_fmt=1/lcd_mode=4. Both extracted contracts use 164-byte panel descriptors; R3II 2025 rotation callback at 160 is present while R3 Pro II is not. These raw fields are not proof that a candidate display implementation is compatible.
Radio GPIO parameters come from each exact extracted model cywdhd.sh; values differ between R3 Pro II and R3II 2025. No board wiring should be inferred from another R3 model or from R1.
validation_state: inventory_only; no SDK build, ABI comparison, module load, device call, firmware repack, or flash was performed
